facts.fact: Telecom Review Africa reports that Liberia, The Gambia and Sierra Leone signed a roaming MoU, with phased benefits scheduled from 2 May 2025 and, for Liberia-Gambia travellers, 1 July 2025; the signing date is not given, so the 2025-02-05 publication date is used.

note: Effect dates are future to the article and nothing says they began, so no effect fact.
